reference.use: Read-only behavior/artwork baseline; only requested asset closure is privately assembled into the ignored artifact.

shader_reference.mechanism: Optional Iris material-map aliases inherit the active pack's own short foliage, tall lower/upper, weeping-vine, and lily-pad classifications; explicit mappings win and pots are excluded.

compatibility_repairs: Cattail cleanup returns source water for a removed waterlogged half so target-version fluid restoration cannot be lost through DoublePlantBlock's air replacement.
Windswept Grass uses the 26.2 vanilla tall-grass paired-half loot structure with the reference output changed to two Windswept Grass items, preventing a second independent half roll.
Bee attraction and bee-food tags are deliberately added for the nine requested flowers; this is an explicit requested addition absent or incomplete in the old reference.
